item.title: DUMOS Nine-Drawer Dressers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
item.company: Jiangsu Jiayubo Furniture Co., Ltd., of China
item.brand: Jiangsu Jiayubo Furniture Co., Ltd., of China
item.summary: This recall involves DUMOS Nine-Drawer Fabric Dressers. They were sold as television stand dressers in white, black, gray and brown, have a metal frame that measures about 13.4 inches wide, 47 inches long and 31.3 inches tall, and weigh 31.5 pounds. The dressers have LED lights and built-in power outlets and ports with an attached electrical cable. SKU WMEDX-FC-TVK9CDC-RT, WMEDX-FC-TVK9CDC-GY, WMEDX-FC-TVK9CDC-BK or WMEDX-FC-TVK9CDC-WT is printed on a label attached to the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: DUMOS Nine-Drawer Dressers.
item.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled dressers if they are not anchored to the wall and place them in an area that children cannot access. Consumers should contact DUMOS for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the dressers by cutting the drawers in half and writing in permanent marker "RECALLED", and to send a photo of the destroyed dressers to dumosdresserrecall@dumos.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled products.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
